content.comment_body: Hello, I need to build an application where a light cycles on and off three times daily, every day of the week. It would be ideal if the operator could adjust the start and stop times. A weekly timer function block may be the most effective solution for this schedule, but is there a way to set the On/Off times for Cam1-Cam3 on the [product_name] operator panel? Thank you in advance.

Hello, Here are screenshots showing how to configure the message text in [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no]: In the message text properties, select the weekly timer, and the available settings for message insertion will appear on the right. Choose the parameter and use the insert parameter button. Adding parameters in message text can only be done with [product_name] Soft Comfort. Hope this is helpful.

Hello, Thanks for your reply. Using that method, I could only display the weekly timer's parameters on the operator display, but couldn't successfully change them with the panel's buttons. I also couldn't find the weekly timer function block parameters under the Set Param menu, contrary to other timer blocks. Additionally, there’s no reference button in the weekly timer block properties for connecting On/Off times to external signals, as is possible for other blocks. Is there another method I could try? Thanks.

Hello, You can only update the program through the display of [product_name] module or by using [product_name] Soft Comfort. In the operator panel, you can modify parameters included in the message text of your program. To change parameters in the operator panel, press the "esc" button for three seconds. When the cursor appears, select the desired parameter using the arrow buttons, then adjust the selected value using "OK" and arrow up/down.
If you want to change all three cam settings, try pressing F1 to cycle through them. Regards,
Hello, Issue resolved. I’m new to [product_name] and was unaware of the 'press esc for 3 seconds' tip. The F1 key idea was also helpful for navigating between cams. Thanks to everyone.

analysis.insight_summary: Users aim to implement a weekly lighting schedule with [company_name] control equipment, relying on the weekly timer function block. They face initial challenges adjusting On/Off times through the operator display and navigating less visible UI features or settings. Most solutions require using the setup software, and some adjustments via the operator panel have usability limits, especially regarding access through external signals or alternative menu paths. Experienced users clarify effective navigation steps, improving understanding for less experienced users, though some operational limitations persist.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to directly and easily adjust weekly timer function block On/Off times from the operator panel, with similar flexibility to other timer blocks and potential integration with external signals for parameter changes.
